name: dev-workflows
description: Seventeen slash commands for the product lifecycle — /idea → /create-prd → /create-ard → /specify → /design → /epics → /implement → /ready — plus a six-command BRD-to-PRD route (/brd-intake → /brd-ground → /brd-split → /brd-interview → /brd-package → /brd-reconcile) that grounds a customer's requirements document, settles it with them, and seeds the PRD, ARD and specification. Twenty-four subagents, four hooks; its shared foundation ships in the companion workflows-core plugin and its documentation tail in docs-workflows. Opus-backed gates review every artifact — plans, code, Epics, specs, designs, ARDs, PRDs, readiness. One markdown tree is the system of record; no tracker is read. Each phase hands its artifact to the next on the specs repo's default branch: the producer opens a PR, the consumer waits for it to land. Optional read-only grounding on product docs and code.
